description: Deck 1 of the loadout spec 10 saves once the pending account has been activated. It exists to prove R111 end to end: the launch grant is "one copy of every non-token card", and R111 records that with MAX_COPIES = 1 and three decks of 20 that is exactly enough for a legal loadout - so a freshly activated account must be able to save one. SPEC §8 cards #1-#20; the spec fills decks 2 and 3 with the next 40 Core ids so all three are disjoint (L4). Nothing here is chosen for its behaviour: spec 10 never starts a game.
